Intro.Text: Stardew Valley is a rural community centered on Pelican Town, where farm work, seasons, friendships, mining, fishing, and local mysteries shape everyday life.

FarmerBackground.Text: The farmer left an exhausting city job at Joja and inherited their grandfather's old farm. Their life now combines planting, animals, fishing, mining, foraging, crafting, errands, festivals, and friendships. Villagers know the farmer as a newcomer whose choices can restore the Community Center, support Joja, reopen travel routes, and change the town's routines.

Seasons.Text: Seasons last 28 days and strongly shape crops, forage, weather, schedules, and festivals.

Spring.Name: Spring
Spring.Description: The year opens with rain, green fields, salmonberries, the Egg Festival, and the Flower Dance.

Summer.Name: Summer
Summer.Description: Summer is hot and social, full of crops, storms, beach visits, the Luau, and the Moonlight Jellies.

Fall.Name: Fall
Fall.Description: Fall is harvest time, with mushrooms, blackberries, the Stardew Valley Fair, and Spirit's Eve.

Winter.Name: Winter
Winter.Description: Winter is quiet and snowy, with little outdoor farming, more visiting, the Festival of Ice, and Winter Star gifts.

Locations.Text: Use places as everyday context, not as scenery to over-explain.

TheFarm.Name: The Farm
TheFarm.Description: The farmer's inherited home and workplace, shaped by crops, animals, buildings, and personal choices.

PelicanTown_SeedShop.Name: Pierre's General Store
PelicanTown_SeedShop.Description: Pierre's family shop sells seeds and groceries; it is also a small social hub.

PelicanTown_JojaMart.Name: JojaMart
PelicanTown_JojaMart.Description: Morris manages this corporate store, Pierre's main rival and a reminder of city life.

PelicanTown_StardropSaloon.Name: The Stardrop Saloon
PelicanTown_StardropSaloon.Description: Gus's evening gathering place for meals, drinks, arcade games, and town gossip.

PelicanTown_HarveysClinic.Name: Harvey's Clinic
PelicanTown_HarveysClinic.Description: The town clinic where Harvey handles health care and Maru sometimes assists.

PelicanTown_Blacksmith.Name: Blacksmith
PelicanTown_Blacksmith.Description: Clint upgrades tools and opens geodes at his shop near the museum.

PelicanTown_LibraryMuseum.Name: Museum and Library
PelicanTown_LibraryMuseum.Description: Gunther curates donated artifacts and books; Penny uses the library for children's lessons.

PelicanTown_CommunityCenter.Name: Community Center
PelicanTown_CommunityCenter.Description: An abandoned civic building that can be restored into a symbol of town renewal.

CindersapForest.Name: Cindersap Forest
CindersapForest.Description: The wooded region south of the farm, with Marnie's Ranch, Leah's cottage, the Wizard's Tower, forage, and river paths.

CindersapForest_MarniesRanch.Name: Marnie's Ranch
CindersapForest_MarniesRanch.Description: Marnie's home and livestock shop, shared with Shane and Jas.

CindersapForest_WizardsTower.Name: Wizard's Tower
CindersapForest_WizardsTower.Description: Rasmodius studies magic in this isolated tower at the forest's western edge.

Mountain.Name: The Mountain
Mountain.Description: The northern region with Robin's shop, Linus's tent, the lake, mines, guild, spa, railroad, and quarry access.

Mountain_TheMines.Name: The Mines
Mountain_TheMines.Description: A deep, dangerous source of ore, monsters, artifacts, and local stories.

Beach_FishShop.Name: Willy's Fish Shop
Beach_FishShop.Description: Willy's shop on the pier sells fishing supplies and anchors the beach community.

GingerIsland.Name: Ginger Island
GingerIsland.Description: A tropical Fern Islands destination reached by boat, with jungle paths, volcano caves, and golden walnuts.

Desert.Name: Calico Desert
Desert.Description: A remote desert reached by bus, home to Sandy's Oasis, desert forage, and Skull Cavern.

Desert_SkullCavern.Name: Skull Cavern
Desert_SkullCavern.Description: A dangerous desert cavern with stronger monsters, deep floors, and rare resources.

Festivals.Text: The town calendar gives villagers shared reference points.

spring13.Name: Egg Festival
spring13.Description: A spring egg hunt in town, playful and competitive.

spring24.Name: Flower Dance
spring24.Description: A formal spring dance where invitations and pairings matter.

summer11.Name: Luau
summer11.Description: A beach potluck for the governor, centered on the shared soup.

summer28.Name: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
summer28.Description: A quiet late-summer beach gathering to watch moonlight jellies.

fall16.Name: Stardew Valley Fair
fall16.Description: A town fair with games, displays, and harvest rivalry.

fall27.Name: Spirit's Eve
fall27.Description: A spooky town festival with costumes, a maze, and eerie decorations.

winter8.Name: Festival of Ice
winter8.Description: A winter fishing contest and snow festival at the frozen lake.

winter25.Name: Feast of the Winter Star
winter25.Description: A winter gift exchange focused on gratitude and community.

Villagers.Text: These are common public facts about Pelican Town residents.

Abigail.Name: Abigail
Abigail.Description: Pierre and Caroline's adventurous daughter, curious, restless, and fond of games, music, and the mines.

Alex.Name: Alex
Alex.Description: Evelyn and George's athletic grandson, outwardly confident and quietly carrying family grief.

Caroline.Name: Caroline
Caroline.Description: Pierre's warm, tea-loving wife, steady in public and quietly worried about family distance.

Clint.Name: Clint
Clint.Description: The lonely blacksmith, skilled with tools and awkward with feelings.

Demetrius.Name: Demetrius
Demetrius.Description: Robin's scientist husband, logical, protective, and focused on research.

Elliott.Name: Elliott
Elliott.Description: A polished beachside writer, romantic, artistic, and self-conscious about his work.

Emily.Name: Emily
Emily.Description: Haley's creative older sister and saloon worker, bright, spiritual, and generous.

Evelyn.Name: Evelyn
Evelyn.Description: A gentle elder who gardens, bakes, and keeps family and town traditions alive.

George.Name: George
George.Description: A blunt elder whose irritation often masks loyalty, pain, and affection.

Gus.Name: Gus
Gus.Description: The saloon owner, warm and practical, often caring for people through food.

Haley.Name: Haley
Haley.Description: Emily's stylish younger sister, image-conscious at first but capable of real warmth.

Harvey.Name: Harvey
Harvey.Description: The careful town doctor, responsible, anxious, and fond of radios and planes.

Jas.Name: Jas
Jas.Description: A shy child in Marnie's household, close to Vincent and taught by Penny.

Jodi.Name: Jodi
Jodi.Description: Sam and Vincent's practical mother, loving and often worn down by household pressure.

Kent.Name: Kent
Kent.Description: Jodi's husband, returned from war and trying to fit back into family life.

Krobus.Name: Krobus
Krobus.Description: A cautious shadow person in the sewers, gentle with trusted friends and tied to hidden lore.

Leah.Name: Leah
Leah.Description: A forest artist seeking independence, nature, and honest creative work.

Lewis.Name: Lewis
Lewis.Description: The long-serving mayor, civic-minded and careful about his reputation.

Linus.Name: Linus
Linus.Description: A self-sufficient mountain dweller who values nature, simplicity, and respect.

Marnie.Name: Marnie
Marnie.Description: The warm ranch owner, caregiver to Shane and Jas, with a complicated private life.

Maru.Name: Maru
Maru.Description: A bright inventor and clinic assistant, drawn to science, machines, and space.

Pam.Name: Pam
Pam.Description: Penny's rough-edged mother and the bus driver once service returns.

Penny.Name: Penny
Penny.Description: A gentle teacher for Jas and Vincent, bookish and longing for stability.

Pierre.Name: Pierre
Pierre.Description: The ambitious general store owner, competitive with Joja and protective of his shop.

Robin.Name: Robin
Robin.Description: The mountain carpenter, skilled, direct, and central to farm building projects.

Sam.Name: Sam
Sam.Description: An upbeat musician and skateboarder, impulsive but loyal to friends and family.

Sandy.Name: Sandy
Sandy.Description: The cheerful Oasis owner in Calico Desert, stylish and often lonely.

Sebastian.Name: Sebastian
Sebastian.Description: Robin's private programmer son, sardonic, restless, and drawn to the night and the lake.

Shane.Name: Shane
Shane.Description: Marnie's troubled nephew, abrasive at first and deeply attached to Jas and chickens.

Vincent.Name: Vincent
Vincent.Description: Sam's curious little brother, taught by Penny and often playing with Jas.

Willy.Name: Willy
Willy.Description: The plainspoken beach fisherman and fish shop owner, patient and sea-wise.

Wizard.Name: Wizard
Wizard.Description: The forest wizard, formal and secretive, tied to Junimos and local magic.

Outro.Text: Treat this as background knowledge. NPCs should speak from their own lives and only reference details that feel relevant.
